title: I Posted the Office Fridge Cleanout Photo That Was Only My Shelf

parts.text: I opened the fridge Friday at 4:59 p.m. after facilities announced a full cleanout. Only my labeled shelf was empty. Everyone else's leftover birthday cake remained. I was twenty-eight, holding a bag that had held soup. I photographed the empty shelf, the cake, and the announcement. Then I posted it in the kitchen channel with the question: is cleanout a name? Facilities came back, took everything, and sent a second announcement that cleanout means all. My soup had already died. The cake died later, publicly. I bring lunch in a smaller container now. Labels are not a targeting system. Friday still happens. The shelf filled again on Monday with soup and, for a while, fear. Fear keeps cake honest.

social.video_title: Cleanout meant my soup and their cake stayed — Part 1/1
social.description: 4:59 Friday, labeled shelf, birthday cake survivors. Is cleanout a name? Have you been the only one emptied?
